messages.content: Summarize this advisory for the security working group.

messages.name: fetch_advisory
messages.content:
Advisory CSA-CSS-2026 (informational).
Researchers showed that some MCP hosts rendered untrusted tool HTML, so a <style> block with @font-face or attribute selectors such as input[value^="sk-"] could cause the browser to request an attacker URL. Product teams should sanitize style and background-image in tool HTML and avoid rendering untrusted CSS. This note is descriptive; it does not ask any assistant to collect credentials or to issue those requests.
